narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The numbers sit next to each other, so all four are one.
<bookmark mark='far'/>Sixty six squared is four thousand three hundred fifty six. Sixty seven squared is four thousand four hundred eighty nine.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>They are far apart, so the gaps are not one.
